BiblicalUsage: Palal, son of Uzai, is one of the men who repair the wall of Jerusalem in Nehemiah's day. He works over against the turning of the wall and the tower that lieth out from the king's high house.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the wall was rebuilt by men like Palal, whose name means judge: God uses ordinary workers, and their names are written down.
